prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1189; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my left ran the signal and struck the side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and pushed it against the curb. I remember the airbag deploying and the sharp pain in my right wrist as I tried to brace myself on the steering wheel. Bystanders stopped to help, and I gave the same account to the responding officer, to the other driver's insurer, and to my own adjuster each time I was asked. I am the named policyholder on this policy and was the operator of my vehicle at the time. I was taken to a local hospital by ambulance, where the wrist was x-rayed and found to be fractured. I am providing this statement so the claim can be processed.
